hypothesis: The equals() method implementation in ZipArchiveEntry does not correctly handle the semantic equivalence between a null comment and an empty string comment, leading to inconsistent equality results depending on how the entry was parsed.
prediction: The equals() method in ZipArchiveEntry likely performs a direct comparison of the comment fields without normalizing nulls to empty strings or vice versa.
